title: The most famous line in Persian prose | Folio 1 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
And then Beyhaqi writes one of the most famous lines in Persian prose. I'll say it in Persian, and then in English. Hasanak tanha mand, chenanke tanha amade bud az shekam-e madar. Hasanak was left alone, just as alone as he had come from his mother's womb. His body, Beyhaqi says, remained on the gallows for about seven years.

The full story: Folio 1: The Vizier on the Gallows — on our channel and on every podcast app.
